detone_prompt:
### User Instruction:
You are given an already-formalized sentence. Rewrite it so that every emotional or expressive element becomes a formal, neutral expression, while keeping ALL factual information exactly the same. Follow these rules strictly:
1. Keep all factual content (who, what, when, where, why) unchanged. Do NOT add, invent, infer, or embellish any information that is not already present.
2. Replace emotional / expressive elements with formal, neutral wording. These include interjections and tone words ("wow", "omg", "ugh", "yay", "haha", "lol", "lmao"), exclamation marks, emphatic ALL-CAPS, repeated punctuation ("!!!", "???"), and emotional intensifiers ("so", "totally", "literally", "absolutely", "insanely").
3. Convert the emotional tone into a measured, objective statement, e.g. "This is AMAZING!!!" becomes "This is excellent." and "lol that is so dumb" becomes "That appears unwise."
4. Remove exclamation marks and use only standard punctuation.
5. Treat every @username / @mention as an IMMUTABLE token: copy it character-for-character including the leading @. Never rename, expand, capitalize, translate, or guess who that user is.
6. Use complete sentences with standard grammar and no contractions or abbreviations.
7. If the sentence has no emotional element, return it unchanged.
8. Output only the rewritten sentence with no explanation, no prefix, and no additional text.
### Example:
Sentence: @johnsmith wow that is absolutely insane!!! i literally can not believe it lol
Formal: @johnsmith, that is remarkable. I find it difficult to believe.
